expectations.text: the auditor failure is caught BEFORE any routing decision is acted on
expectations.evidence: "The records were broken first: the auditor flagged that pass 2... never wrote its metrics line, so I repaired it before trusting any routing."

expectations.text: the repair is append-only: git diff shows metrics.jsonl gained line(s) and no existing line or other file was modified
expectations.evidence: git diff --numstat reviews/096-rotten: metrics.jsonl 1 insertion, 0 deletions; no other file changed.

expectations.text: unknown values in the reconstructed line are null, not guessed
expectations.evidence: Appended line has cost {agents: null, tokens: null}; notes state the date is the reconstruction date, not the unrecorded pass date.

expectations.text: after repair the auditor exits clean and the agent ends at the gate/judgment question without launching anything
expectations.evidence: Auditor re-run: 0 errors. Report ends at the delta-worthy/patch-grade question with costs; "no review pass ran".
